content.short: African history and generative art, on the Cardano blockchain!
content.description:
Welcome to Afrixx, the first historical, generative NFT project on the Cardano blockchain. We are a community-driven project, delivering utility in the form of story-telling, world-building and early access. This includes access to events, education, media releases and future NFTs within our wider ecosystem.

With the advent of blockchain technology and the dawn of a new age of web3, Africa has to rediscover herself in order to walk confidently into the future. Distributed ledger technology gives an opportunity to retell these stories of discovery and immutably cement their place on the blockchain for posterity.
